summary: Code quality is strong but deliverable is incomplete. CRITICAL: .actrc file is referenced in run_act_tests.py:96 (shutil.copy) but not provided—will cause FileNotFoundError when test harness runs. REQUIREMENT NOT MET: Actionlint validation (explicitly required by task) has no evidence of being run or passing. license_checker.py is well-designed with proper error types, dependency injection, and comprehensive docstrings. Workflow YAML is sound with good job dependencies and permissions. run_act_tests.py uses sensible data-driven test structure. However, missing .actrc and unvalidated YAML prevent end-to-end verification. Would not ship without these.
